Separately, SIN3B/HDAC is recruited by repressive E2F4-p130/p107 complexes, while Multicilin forms an E2F4/5-DP1 activator complex that selectively induces centriole-assembly genes such as PLK4, CEP152, and STIL. literature_rationale: Generic E2F derepression is not a complete directional prediction of this selective program: activator E2F1-3, repressive E2F4/5-SIN3/DREAM complexes, and the Multicilin-E2F4/5-DP1 activator have different targets and regulatory signs. Centriole, centrosome, and ciliary-basal-body genes are parts of the same measured organelle program; their relationship is not the missing edge.

documented_expectation: KIF1Bβ loss impairs anterograde transport of synaptic-vesicle precursors and presynaptic cargo, predicting attenuation of a presynaptic molecular readout such as SNAP25.
literature_rationale: The references provide a target-specific bridge from KIF1Bβ disruption to defective presynaptic-vesicle transport. The observed Snap25 decrease is directionally consistent with attenuation of that presynaptic program, although SNAP25 transcription itself was not directly tested.
